html:
If you have the opportunity to visit the small village of Ha My – Quang Nam, visitors should enjoy the delicious and attractive Tam Huu dish to feel the unique delicious flavor of the Central region.

To prepare this delicious and attractive dish, you need 3 main ingredients, which are shrimp, pork belly and basil, onion, coriander… Although the ingredients are quite simple, they bring a delicious and unique flavor.

According to the housewives here, to have a delicious Tam Huu dish, you must first buy shrimp early in the morning when they are just caught in the net in the Lo Gach River, De Vong River, Ben Tre River…

With pork belly cut a few centimeters long, roll it out a little, add a stalk of scallion and dip it in boiling water, a little basil, roll it into Tam Huu dish.

The sweetness of shrimp, pork, pork belly, the aroma of onion stalks and vegetables bring an irresistible aroma. This is a delicious dish often used to entertain distinguished guests, or on death anniversaries, the dish of tam huu is indispensable.

If you are a tourist from the Central region, you are certainly no stranger to the delicious and attractive dish like tam huu, the fragrant aroma of a simple dish but full of the flavor of the countryside, so if you have the opportunity to travel to Da Nang, please enjoy this delicious and attractive dish.
